task_prompt: Write a function to calculate whether the matrix is a magic square.
final_code:
def magic_square_test(my_matrix):
    iSize = len(my_matrix)
    sum_list = []
    sum_list.extend([sum(row) for row in my_matrix])
    for col in range(iSize):
        sum_list.append(sum(row[col] for row in my_matrix))

    # Primary diagonal (top-left to bottom-right)
    primary_diag = sum(my_matrix[i][i] for i in range(iSize))
    sum_list.append(primary_diag)

    # Anti-diagonal (top-right to bottom-left)
    anti_diag = sum(my_matrix[i][iSize-1-i] for i in range(iSize))
    sum_list.append(anti_diag)

    return len(set(sum_list)) == 1
